reference_review.limitations: The fixture truth 0.25 is a rounded value of the exact standardised ATE (about 0.257); the band 0.08 is wide enough that the rounding does not matter. The unadjusted-contrast exclusion is the population value (about 0.373); the executing test applies the same exclusion to its own sample. The assertion is a finite-sample band on an estimator output at n=2000, not an efficiency or calibration claim.
